blocks.content: Traditional water conservation and river worship festival in Tamil Nadu.

items: Aadi Perukku (also known as Aadi18) is a traditional water and monsoon festival celebrated on the 18th day of the Tamil month of Aadi.
Expresses gratitude to Mother Nature and the Cauvery River for sustaining agriculture and life.
